title: Two Dolphins Stayed Alert for 15 Days Straight. The Test Stopped, Not Them

scenes.text: Two dolphins stayed alert for fifteen days straight, and the test ended before they did.
Scientists asked them to listen for sounds all day and all night with echolocation.
Their accuracy stayed near perfect, with no drop at all.
The trick is sleeping with half the brain at a time, while the other half stays awake.
The researchers never tested how much longer they could go.
A dolphin never fully switches off. Not even for two weeks.

description:
Two dolphins stayed alert for fifteen days straight with no drop in accuracy.
They rest one half of the brain at a time.
Could you stay awake one night?
first_comment: How long can you stay awake? Tell us.
